notes.title: ShotSurged 0.7.2 - The Storefront Update, out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings playtesters,


0.7.2 is out now! Below you can find the patch notes.


Added


 Added “The Shop”, A new way for you to be rewarded for playing the game
 Added an operator menu
 6 brand new weapons
 New calling cards & emblems
 New Operator | Ace
 New Operator | Infamy
 New Operator | Crosby
 New themes and announcer for Exodus Outcome
 Experimental - Added damage number indicator into the UI


Fixes


 Fixed an issue where players would fall into a million pieces upon death
 Resolved an issue where you could not hit certain areas of the player (Still In Testing!)
 Fixed an issue where the barracks menu didn’t show your calling card but instead a placeholder calling card
 Fixed some icon clipping in the progression menu
 Fixed multiple examples of text clipping in the clan menu
 Fixed an issue where you couldn't change keybinds in the main menu due to the notice popup not being assigned
 Fixed an issue where the legs were still showing in first person whilst prone


Tweaks


 Updated ringers portrait
 Adjusted some text in the english localization
 UI Tweak - Changed the UI to look better & more minimal
 UI Tweak - Added a healthbar to the player UI
 UI Tweak - Changed the font of the low health text
 Changed the M4A1s sights, by default they now use iron sights
 Added a red dot to the RFR, since its iron sights looked awful
 Changed the sound of the Calisto-47


You may encounter some bugs in 0.7.2, by chance you do you can report them to us via our discord. Additionally you can check our trello for the bugs we're already aware of, links below.

https://discord.gg/HY9au2Pznm
https://trello.com/b/TShTf9c8/shotsurged-roadmap

Happy Hunting!
